$comment: Perf budgets for the M0 reference scenes (plan §10, ADR-0007). Draw calls include the colour pass, the moon shadow pass, the G-buffer for line art and character outlines. Frame time is measured under SwiftShader in CI, hence the generous ceiling. market-tpp (M2): the Targ district streamed in, Shinsekai streamed out; measured 182 draw calls / 80 active meshes. ADR-0021 (fire escape, balcony, three ladders and roof parapets on the south row): measured 248 draw calls / 109 active meshes. docks (ADR-0024): east end of the quay looking west (water and mist, crane, office), the docks yard and quay streamed in and nothing else; measured 190 draw calls / 82 active meshes. ADR-0026 (Kenta, Fumiko and Goro behind the north stalls, Sachiko at the kiosk, the people of Ulica Kanałowa down the street behind the gate, the car on the deck): measured 301 draw calls / 120 active meshes; the four market keepers alone are 20 draw calls. ADR-0027 (dressing per chunk, bare-structure skins, far city): reference 102 -> 101 draw calls / 34 -> 35 active meshes, street-tpp 211 -> 210 / 81 -> 82, market-tpp 301 -> 304 / 120 -> 123, docks 190 -> 198 / 82 -> 87; budgets unchanged. ADR-0030 (signs, holo-ads and street reflections in one always-active mesh; the gameplay post-process is off the camera while idle): reference 101 -> 102 / 35 -> 36, street-tpp 210 -> 211 / 82 -> 83, market-tpp 304 -> 305 / 123 -> 124, docks 198 -> 199 / 87 -> 88; budgets unchanged. ADR-0036 (wet-asphalt probe renders only on a district change, trail beams and the metro car are disabled while idle): reference 102 / 36 unchanged, docks 211 / 94 after the wave 2 merges; the metro car alone (models=off) 61 / 12; budgets unchanged. ADR-0038 (clinic and Neon Koi interiors, doors, the barman and two regulars; plain interior blocks merged per preset and 64 m cell, no moon shadow; without the merge 152 / 360): reference 132, street-tpp 301 draw calls; budgets raised to 135 and 305. ADR-0041 (sidewalks baked into the chunk dressing, the crowd of residents in one shared mesh with outline, no moon shadow): reference 132 / 47 unchanged, street-tpp 297 -> 301 / 120 -> 121, market-tpp 303 -> 307 / 123 -> 124, docks 227 / 100 unchanged (empty at night); budgets unchanged. ADR-0045 (the game in Lublin; old scenes street-tpp, market-tpp and docks replaced): measured with the test stepping the game (ADR-0046, models=off, SwiftShader), draw calls / active meshes: reference (Neon Koi in its tenement) 179 / 73, krakowskie-tpp (the deptak west of the clinic, walking east) 369 / 156, rynek-tpp (up Bramowa onto the Rynek) 204 / 80, podzamcze-tpp (the market under the viaduct from its east end) 289 / 114, nabrzeze (the quay at night) 266 / 114, phone-low (800x370, quality low, touch, on the deptak) 231 / 145; the same in two runs. Budgets a few percent above. Frame time is reported in reports/perf.json, not checked (ADR-0046). ADR-0048 (Stare Miasto: gate passages lined, the footbridge, bracket signs, Hebi patrols, Trasa Podziemna in a chunk of its own): rynek-tpp 204 / 80 -> 226 / 86 (at 21:01 a Hebi patrol walks the Rynek in view, 4 meshes, and the TRASA PODZIEMNA sign over the Trybunal's door, 2; the cellars stream in only near the Trybunal, with them in the Rynek's chunk it was 262 / 104); budget 210 / 84 -> 232 / 90; the other scenes unchanged. ADR-0049 (80 degrees across instead of ~94 at 16:9, TPP 2.2 m at eye height instead of 2.7 m, the reference camera 1.15 m further back to keep its framing): measured the same way in two runs, draw calls / active meshes before -> after: reference 179 / 73 -> 167 / 67, krakowskie-tpp 369 / 156 -> 359 / 151, rynek-tpp 204 / 80 -> 187 / 71, podzamcze-tpp 289 / 114 -> 256 / 96, nabrzeze 266 / 114 -> 226 / 95, phone-low 231 / 145 -> 227 / 141. Budgets lowered to a few percent above. Merged (ADR-0048 + ADR-0049): rynek-tpp measured 209 / 77 with the patrol and the Trasa sign in the narrower view; budget 215 / 81. ADR-0050 (street furniture in the game baked per 256 m block with one halo mesh for the city, the crowd at 32/18/6 per chunk drawn to 90/70/40 m, the traffic in one shared mesh and the parked cars in another): measured with the same steps, draw calls / active meshes before -> after: reference 167 / 67 -> 178 / 73, krakowskie-tpp 357 / 151 -> 375 / 159, rynek-tpp 209 / 77 -> 221 / 84, podzamcze-tpp 256 / 96 -> 275 / 105, nabrzeze 224 / 94 -> 230 / 97, phone-low 226 / 141 -> 232 / 147. Of the new meshes 6 to 7 are the furniture (near blocks, far blocks, halos), 1 the vehicles, 1 the parked cars; the furniture as thin instances per kind (ADR-0047) cost 17 to 20 meshes on the deptak (15 draw calls more than now). Budgets a few percent above. ADR-0051 (vertical Lublin 2077: superstructures, wall clutter, cables, footbridges and ads baked into the existing cell meshes; the skyline of corporate towers as two impostor meshes, 3 draw calls with the G-buffer; mist only down the busy canyons, so the Rynek's cells need no new sign mesh for it): measured on top of ADR-0049, before -> after, draw calls / active meshes: reference 167 / 67 -> 170 / 69, krakowskie-tpp 359 / 151 -> 363 / 154, rynek-tpp 209 / 77 -> 218 / 83, podzamcze-tpp 256 / 96 -> 261 / 100, nabrzeze 224 / 94 -> 228 / 97, phone-low 227 / 141 -> 228 / 142 (low: no tower lights). Only rynek-tpp went over its budget: 215 / 81 -> 225 / 87; the others stay within theirs. Merged with the outdoor steps and the lamp shafts on the map's ground: podzamcze-tpp 262 / 101 (one mesh over), budget 263 / 100 -> 270 / 104. Merged ADR-0050 + ADR-0051 (furniture, crowd and traffic with vertical Lublin), measured: reference 183 / 76, krakowskie-tpp 379 / 162, rynek-tpp 232 / 90, podzamcze-tpp 281 / 110, nabrzeze 235 / 101, phone-low 233 / 148 (ADR-0050 alone: 178 / 73, 375 / 159, 221 / 84, 275 / 105, 230 / 97, 232 / 147). Over budget and raised a few percent above: rynek-tpp 228 / 87 -> 239 / 93, podzamcze-tpp 283 / 109 -> 290 / 113, nabrzeze 232 / 99 -> 242 / 104; the others stay within theirs. Streaks of the game's own neon and lamps on the map's ground (Atmosphere.addReflection put every streak at y = 0.03 whatever the ground; under the viaduct the market lies some 12 m below the map's anchor, so its five streaks hung in the air out of view) and lights hidden behind buildings out of the glow layer: podzamcze-tpp 281 / 110 -> 286 / 115 in two runs, the other scenes unchanged; activeMeshes budget 113 -> 118. G-052 (Krakowskie to z = -270, Teatr Osterwy and the Bernardines): reference 181 / 76 -> 191 / 81 in two runs (map-ground +2, map-far +1, map-near +1, map-signs +1: the camera inside Neon Koi looks south-west and its frustum holds the new strip behind the walls), the other scenes unchanged; budget raised by the measured increase, 184 / 76 -> 194 / 81 (debt in ADR-0046). ADR-0058 stage 7 (drones over the street canyons: all of them in one shared mesh on the city kit's material, the only new draw calls ADR-0058 allows, one and one more with the G-buffer, no glow pass; none on low quality): measured with the same steps on main a86cd7c -> the branch, draw calls / active meshes: reference 191 / 81 -> 193 / 82 (the camera inside Neon Koi has the deptak's lane in its frustum behind the walls, not in the picture: the snapshot is unchanged), krakowskie-tpp 373 / 163 -> 375 / 164, rynek-tpp 230 / 90 -> 232 / 91, podzamcze-tpp 282 / 113 -> 284 / 114, nabrzeze 236 / 102 and phone-low 227 / 149 unchanged. Only the reference's meshes went over: 81 -> 82 (debt in ADR-0046, with G-052); its draw calls stay within 194, the others within theirs. ADR-0063 stage 6 (the market off Aleja Tysiąclecia, its people in Alchemia; the scene stands where it was, on the avenue, looking west): measured on main b65bd52 -> the branch, draw calls / active meshes: podzamcze-tpp 284 / 114 -> 153 / 65 (the market's blocks, stalls, signs and people gone; the map's garages and kiosk, the furniture and the traffic back), the other scenes unchanged (reference 193 / 82, krakowskie-tpp 375 / 164, rynek-tpp 232 / 91, nabrzeze 236 / 102, phone-low 227 / 149). Budget lowered to a few percent above: 290 / 118 -> 160 / 68. Alchemia, 166 m and more from every scene, has no scene of its own yet. ADR-0074 stage 1 (Alchemia rebuilt: the food hall under its terrace, its outside in one mesh within 135 m, its inside in a second one within 45 m of its walls with one lamp; the old hall, stalls and lift gone): the other scenes measured unchanged (reference 193 / 82, krakowskie-tpp 375 / 164, rynek-tpp 232 / 91, podzamcze-tpp 153 / 65, nabrzeze 236 / 102, phone-low 227 / 149); the new scene alchemia-tpp (on T1 before the way in, looking north-east to the Arkady) measured 209 / 79, budget a few percent above: 216 / 82. Review of #343 (the hall from afar: a stand-in of its shell in the street furniture's block meshes, no draw call of its own; the scene turned to have the hall in the frame, on T1 walking south to its front): alchemia-tpp 263 / 101 in two runs, budget 271 / 104; the other scenes unchanged. ADR-0074 stage 2 (T2, its stairs and the Arkady rebuilt in Alchemia's outside mesh, no draw call of their own; the map's ruin gone): alchemia-tpp 263 / 101 and the other scenes unchanged; the new scene alchemia-t2-tpp (on the stairs from T1 walking down to T2, the Arkady's arches in the frame) measured 194 / 71 in two runs, budget a few percent above: 200 / 74. ADR-0074 stage 4 (P-1 under the car park: its ramp trench and stair house in Alchemia's outside mesh, the room in a mesh of its own within 30 m with one lamp, the moving cars and the cabins' shutters in one small mesh within 40 m): the new scene alchemia-p1 (on the apron by the ramp's foot walking north-west to the hand-over cabins) measured 203 / 71 in two runs, budget a few percent above: 210 / 74; alchemia-tpp 263 / 101 -> 261 / 100 (the P-1 meshes off there), alchemia-t2-tpp 194 / 71 and the other scenes unchanged. G-495 (models.spec read the perf of the last frame drawn before its steps, the start's, 323 to 326 draw calls / 0 active meshes, against a draw-call constant of its own): the scene models (a new game with the cast on, seed 11, the clinic with 12 dressed) now samples a frame drawn after its steps with the city settled, as the scenes above; measured 448 / 152, budget a few percent above: 465 / 158 (the constant was 495 draw calls, active meshes unchecked). G-556 (buildings whose centre lies off the map clipped to its edge, parts at least 3 m deep): two restored buildings stand in render cells that had none and each adds one merged map-far mesh, the clipping itself adds no mesh: reference 193 / 82 -> 196 / 84 (Urszulanki school r14476826 in cell 1:-3, its map-far and map-signs), krakowskie-tpp 375 / 164 -> 377 / 165 (XVI LO w66330436 in cell 3:-3); budgets raised by the measured increase, reference 194 / 82 -> 196 / 84, krakowskie-tpp active meshes 164 -> 165 (debt in ADR-0046, decision of the user 11.11). G-522 (#409, kerb fills: the gaps between carriageway and paving laid as asphalt or pavement): the ground of chunk krakowskie-1-0 gives the kerb room for one more parked car (91 -> 92 in the city), a delivery van at (153.7, -147.9); it lies in the frustum of the camera inside Neon Koi, about 60 m off its nearest plane, hidden only by the walls; the parked fleet's mesh is drawn for it (G-595 culls it by the frustum, not by the walls): measured on main 2fac07d merged, reference 196 / 84 -> 199 / 85 (the same +3 / +1 as on the branch before the merge, 193 / 82 -> 196 / 83), the other scenes within theirs; budget raised by the measured increase, 196 / 84 -> 199 / 85 (debt in ADR-0046, decision of the user 12.11).
